'''March 2002 Minnesota tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Outpost 2000 on 16 March 2002. [[Garrett Larson]] won it. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3518">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-21-deadbody-heads-to-outpost-3-16-02d3518/ deadbody-heads-to-outpost-3-16-02], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 21 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-21-deadbody-heads-to-outpost-3-16-02d3518/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 March 2002
* '''Site:''' Outpost 2000
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Players:''' 5
* '''Winner:''' [[Garrett Larson]]
